verdict.rationale: Natural language is the API's core interface. Users generate text from plain prompts 'as you might using ChatGPT' [gpt-docs-1]. The model can turn natural-language requests into actions via function calling, built-in tools and remote MCP servers [gpt-docs-7, gpt-docs-19, gpt-docs-24]. Agents can plan and complete tasks across steps [gpt-docs-27, gpt-docs-10]. Access still goes through an API key and SDK or HTTP code [gpt-docs-2, gpt-docs-3], and community reports note non-deterministic results for the same input [gpt-comm-9]. Missing for 10: evidence that platform administration (keys, projects, settings) can be done by natural-language command, a no-code natural-language control surface for the API itself, and hands-on corroboration of reliable command execution.
